reasoning: The icon depicts a play triangle inside a half-dashed circle, the standard glyph for slow-motion video, stories, or partially watched media. It works well for tasks centered on watching tutorials, resuming videos, or editing slow-mo clips, though at list size it is easily confused with a plain circled play button.

pass1.ambiguity: At small sizes the dashed left half of the ring blends together, making it look almost identical to a standard circled play button; its specific UI meaning (slow-mo vs. story vs. resume playback) is not universally known outside camera and media apps.
